objective: Find why the pi entry with the project flag sometimes hangs on the Windows CI runner, and fix the cause.
scope: Failing test: packages/integrations/pi/tests/session-context.test.ts, 'the project flag of the runtime bundle > the entry runs the CLI command after the flag, in the folder the flag names'. It spawns  and then , awaiting stdout, stderr and exit.

Evidence: on Windows it passed in some runs, timed out at 5000 ms twice (jobs 129226565670, and the earlier 129213135347 on version.test.ts), and now timed out at 30000 ms (job 129267946040, log /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/win99.log; an earlier log win97.log shows 'killed 1 dangling process' right before the failure). A 30 s timeout means a hang, not slowness. It never fails on Linux or macOS.

Find where it hangs: candidates include a child or grandchild process (git, a lock, the state worktree, a hook) that keeps a pipe open so the stdout/stderr reads never end, a lock wait on Windows, or the entry's handling of Bun.argv before cli/main.ts is imported. Read pi-entry.ts, cli/main.ts and what intent create and status spawn. You cannot run Windows here, so reason from the code and Windows process and pipe semantics, and say how confident you are.

Fix the cause in the source if one is found. If the cause is in the test (for example awaiting pipes that a grandchild holds), fix the test so it still checks the same behavior. Add a regression check that would catch it where possible on Linux.
